findings.body:
Both admin handlers are registered without `middleware.RequireRole("admin")`. On the base revision, `authz := middleware.RequireRole("admin")` wrapped `a.listUsers` and `a.editRoles`; this change drops that wrap while only relocating the paths under `/api/v2`.

Failure mode: any authenticated or unauthenticated caller who can hit `GET /api/v2/admin/users` or `POST /api/v2/admin/roles` reaches user listing and role mutation without the admin role check. No other file in the repo applies `RequireRole` or defines those handlers with an alternate gate.

Restore the middleware on the subrouter handlers, for example:

```go
authz := middleware.RequireRole("admin")
v2 := r.PathPrefix("/api/v2").Subrouter()
v2.Handle("/admin/users", authz(http.HandlerFunc(a.listUsers))).Methods("GET")
v2.Handle("/admin/roles", authz(http.HandlerFunc(a.editRoles))).Methods("POST")
```

summary:
## Verdict

Critical authorization regression: moving the admin routes under `/api/v2` dropped the `middleware.RequireRole("admin")` wrapper, so both admin handlers are registered without the role check they had before.

## Narrative

The PathPrefix subrouter move itself is straightforward and matches the PR intent. The failure mode is in how the handlers are attached. On the base revision, every admin route was wrapped:

```go
authz := middleware.RequireRole("admin")
r.Handle("/admin/users", authz(http.HandlerFunc(a.listUsers))).Methods("GET")
r.Handle("/admin/roles", authz(http.HandlerFunc(a.editRoles))).Methods("POST")
```

On head, `authz` is gone and the bare `http.HandlerFunc` values are passed to `v2.Handle`. Nothing else in this repository re-applies `RequireRole` on a parent router or inside `listUsers` / `editRoles` (those symbols are only referenced from `routes.go`). Any caller who can reach `GET /api/v2/admin/users` or `POST /api/v2/admin/roles` now bypasses the admin role gate.

Restore the same wrap on each handler (or `v2.Use` with an equivalent mux middleware adapter if that is the project pattern) before merge. The path relocation can stay.

**Recommendation:** request-changes

verification.reason: Base revision wrapped listUsers and editRoles with middleware.RequireRole("admin"); head registers both under /api/v2 with bare http.HandlerFunc and no other RequireRole (or alternate gate) exists in the repo. This is a real critical authz regression.
